setAside.oracleRef: Arithmetic under the set-aside composition rules of #10 and #15, computed by an independent Decimal script written from those rules and the sources below, not by running the engine. Re-derived for #39 on 2026-09-27 by a new independent Decimal script, written without reading the engine, which first reproduced every earlier expected value of this golden under the earlier TGSS rule and then changed only that rule. Actuals are the cumulative closed quarters; the projection is spread evenly over the months after the last of them. TGSS (#39): LGSS art. 308.1.c 1.ª–3.ª (boe.es consolidated RDL 8/2015, read 2026-09-27): rendimiento computable = IRPF rendimiento neto plus the titular's own cuotas (1.ª), less 7 % gastos genéricos (2.ª, config seguridadSocial.gastosGenericos), spread over the months of alta (3.ª). The net is Modelo 100 casilla 0224 and the cuotas casilla 0186 (AEAT, Información para determinar el rendimiento neto, sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 18 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-27); casilla 0224 is after difícil justificación (RD 439/2007 art. 30.2ª: 5 %, at most 2,000) and before every LIRPF art. 32 reduction and the other reductions Modelo 100 2025 takes after it, in casillas 0225, 0232–0234 and 0236–0237 (Anexo I, página 9), so the art. 32.3 reduction does not lower it. Casilla 0224 is the year's ingresos less its gastos, the actual ones with the cuotas charged and the projected ones with the projected cuotas, less difícil justificación. Every month's cuota is priced at the highest tramo consistent with the monthly figure it leads to; tarifa plana 80 for the alta month and the twelve complete calendar months after it, Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter.1 (boe.es consolidated text, read 2026-09-26); the month of alta prorated by days of alta / 30 as MonthlyCuotaCalculator does (#7). Modelo 130: AEAT instrucciones del modelo 130 (sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es, page updated 11 Sep 2026, read 2026-09-26), casillas 01–19, and RD 439/2007 art. 30.2ª and 110 (difícil justificación in casilla 02; casilla 12 floors 07 at zero; casilla 14 = 12 − 13 may be negative; casilla 15 deducts earlier negative casilla 19 results, at most a positive casilla 14). Annual: SPEC-002 steps 1, 2, 4 and 6, LIRPF art. 19, 20, 30.2.4ª, 32.3, 56, 63 and 74, VC mínimo 6,105 (Ley 13/1997 art. 2 bis). Hold-back share (Σ 130 + gap + Σ cuotas SS) / annual ingresos, rounded up to 0.0001. No AEAT simulator, published example or gestor covers a set-aside estimate; this is the weakest gate. Tarifa plana ended with 2025-06 (Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter.1). TGSS: the year's picture is G17's (35,000 ingresos, 3,835.10 gastos with the cuotas), so casilla 0224 29,606.655, plus 3,035.10 of cuotas = 32,641.755, × 0.93 / 12 = 2,529.74 a month, General 7, 425.85 from July; year 3,035.10; the Q3 months are 425.85 each, so the monthly cuota is 425.85 and no tarifa plana warning is raised. Due window (#40): RD 439/2007 art. 111.1 and Orden EHA/672/2007 art. 7 give 1–20 of the month, and a last day that is a Saturday, Sunday or holiday of the taxpayer's region moves to the next working day (Orden EHA/672/2007 art. 7; Ley 39/2015 art. 30.5–30.6; boe.es, read 2026-09-27); 20 October 2025 is a Monday and no holiday in the Comunitat Valenciana (BOE-A-2024-26935), so it stands. #52 (2026-09-27): the actuals state the RETA cuotas paid, cuotasSsYtd 240.00 to March and 480.00 to June, the tarifa plana months the gastos already held; paid equals priced, so no expected value moves, as the #52 script confirmed. #55 (2026-09-27): the taxpayer states the base de cotización paid from the end of the actuals on, baseCotizacion 1,356.21, G17's; from July 1,356.21 × 0.314 = 425.85 is debited each month, the figure priced before, between General 7's 425.85 and 866.64 (2,760.00 × 0.314), so TGSS keeps it, and the tarifa plana months to June are not regularised (Ley 20/2007 art. 38 ter.6); no expected value moves, as the #55 script confirmed.
